resources.string: A shallow cave where little imps play pranks on the unwary. The perfect first trial for a brand-new Seeker!
A gloomy cave where Petty Envy and Gnawing Doubt fester side by side. A good place for new Apprentices to rough-hew their first vices.
A cavern veiled in webs of half-truths, spun by the Weavers of Lies. Bring a clear mind!
A camp of profanes who would rather take than build. Keep an eye on your purse!
An old crypt where those who never woke to the Light still shuffle through the dark. Beware their stubborn slumber!
The fallen stones of the First Temple, now held by vainglorious knights and overzealous wardens.
A rough-walled fortress high in the mountains, where Brutes settle every question by force. Only steady hearts dare enter.
A scorching cavern where the Hounds of Wrath howl among lesser vices. Keep your temper: the heat is unbearable!
The legendary lair of the Green Dragons of Envy. Only seasoned Masters come back with their composure intact.
The peaceful forecourt before the Temple, roamed by gossiping hens, blind followers and ruminating sloth. Ideal for beginners gathering provisions for the banquet!
A fortress of fire and sulfur where every vice keeps a hall of its own. The heat alone can overwhelm the unprepared.
An ancient temple watched over by the most formidable guardians of the realm. Only the most accomplished Masons dare cross its threshold.
A tear in the order of things, through which the Darkness spills into the world of the living.
An ancient fortress sealed in a glacier, where cold hearts and colder reasoning keep an eternal vigil.
The deepest point of the known world, where the lords of the Abyss have reigned since before the first Light.
The ruin of a sun tower, cracked open at the solstice and spilling restless heat spirits across the land. Part of the Summer St John\'s Feast event.
A mist-drowned marsh of forgotten barrows, where those who lost their way at harvest time still wander. Part of the Autumn Equinox event.

A realm above the clouds, reached by climbing a ladder of legend. Giants roam vast floating islands, sky serpents drift between the cloudbanks, and storm imps crackle with restless energy. Few have seen it. Fewer still have come back to speak of it.
A withered forest deep past the Marsh of Oblivion, where the fiercest horrors of the season gather. Part of the Autumn Equinox event.
The legendary three-headed dragon of Tyranny, who demands obedience and gives nothing in return.
The ancient master of every vice, who whispers that a little indulgence never hurt anyone.
The terror of the deep seas, a colossal tangle of chaos that drags all order down into the depths.
An ancient flame of zeal and shadow, woken from its slumber deep beneath the earth. It burns all that does not think as it does.
The primordial power behind the rifts of Darkness. Ancient beyond reckoning, it regards those who seek the Light with contempt.
A shard of the sun itself, torn loose from the ruins of the Sun Tower. Only the boldest Masons dare approach.
The headless sovereign of the Autumn Equinox, riding out of the Blighted Wood to reap what the living have sown.
A colossus of living gold, woken when the Eternal Flame was lit. Only the patrons of the Temple of Solomon may face it.
A mountain given wrath. No lone Mason has ever chipped more than a scar into it. Gather your Brethren.
Mother of a swarm of lies between the stars. Her brood has toppled empires; your visitors had better be warmly welcomed.
When it stirs, cities write their wills. Four names in the register, or none return.
A vast cavern beneath the copper galleries. Trolls of Obstinacy and Rough Ashlar Golems haunt the rubble, while quarry spiders spin webs across the fallen shafts.
A network of underground chambers where the region\'s ruffians plot. False brothers, cutpurses and shadow creatures lurk in every corner.
Ancient ruins that stand both above and below the world of the living. Strange abyssal creatures flicker in and out of reality.
Stone ruins swallowed by the cedar forest, now haunted by feral creatures and the bitter spirits of fallen hermits.
The great forge where the pillars were cast, still burning after centuries without pause. Forge demons and iron golems jealously guard its secrets.
The still-working underground halls of a ruined hermetic school. Arcane automatons and enchanted guardians still patrol its corridors.
A shadow-drenched sanctum at the heart of the withered canopy. Corrupted adepts and shadow beasts guard an ancient evil.
A temple swallowed beneath the sunken grotto, its flooded halls claimed by drowned fanatics and creatures of the deep.
The inner refuge of the false brothers, open only to those who have proven their bad faith.
The innermost lair of the three ruffians who conspired against the Master. Jubelas, Jubelos and Jubelum await.
The isle\'s landing place. Shore marauders pick over the wrecks of earlier voyages. Every clear has a chance to drop Keystones.
A symbol-laced forest grown over an old library. Grove stalkers and symbol-touched dryads keep visitors from the ruins beneath. Every clear has a chance to drop Keystones.
The isle\'s smoking spine, once an altar of the Ancients. Ash beasts and lava wraiths guard the sealing site. Every clear has a chance to drop Keystones.
A flooded pressure chamber at the foot of the isle, where the Last Elder waits. Abyssal horrors and fallen seraphs patrol the approach. Every clear drops Keystones.
The guardian of the crossing. A symbol-scarred serpent that circles the isle and turns back everyone it doesn\'t drown. Defeat it once to permanently open the crossing to the Isle of the East.
The last of the Ancients, sealed at the bottom of the Abyssal Depths. Only a full set of Ancient regalia can withstand this trial.
A wind-scoured snowfield where the creatures of winter drift down from the peaks. Part of the Winter St John\'s Feast event.
Blue-lit caverns carved through the glacier, home to the fiercest beasts of winter. Part of the Winter St John\'s Feast event.
A meadow gone wild with the spring thaw, its flowers hiding thorns and teeth. Part of the Spring Equinox event.
An ancient grove past the Thornmeadow, where the Thorn Queen\'s court takes root. Part of the Spring Equinox event.
An ancient wyrm of living ice that wakes each winter solstice, burying the Glacier Hollows in endless cold.
The briar-crowned ruler of the Wildgrove, whose roses bloom each spring with thorns as long as chisels.
